name: The Langham Hotel, Hong Kong
positioning: Luxury hotel in the heart of Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, with a Palm Court styled after the one at The Langham, London
best_for: Travelers who want to stay in the heart of Tsim Sha Tsui
Guests who want afternoon tea at Palm Court and a spa with a rooftop pool

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon.
Guests in Executive Rooms and Suites have complimentary access to The Langham Club.
The Harmony Suite has a separate living room and two bathrooms.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the lobby as having marble floors, beige marble walls and a towering chandelier.
Each room has an Italian marble bathroom with a soak tub and a separate rain shower, according to Condé Nast Traveler.
Condé Nast Traveler found a Nespresso machine in the room.
The Bostonian Seafood & Grill and Main St. Deli are also in the building.

highlights.text: Palm Court is styled after its namesake at The Langham, London, where British Afternoon Tea was first served in 1865.
The hotel has an art collection by Chinese artists, placed in public areas from the lobby to the restaurants and bar.
The Director Suite has a living room with a library of films on a 46-inch smart TV.
The health club has a rooftop heated pool and Jacuzzi.
The hotel has two recognised Les Clefs d'Or concierges, according to Condé Nast Traveler.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes a busy urban location with city noise.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
Complimentary access to The Langham Club comes with Executive Rooms and Suites.
